title: Community college student (family, grocery cashier, 5 classes, 15 credits, Canvas, afternoon steady) gets her History final moved to Fri Dec 11, 4 to 6 PM, and a Friday 5 to 10 PM shift is added the same day; Dev drafts the schedule request, books review blocks before the exam and nothing over it.

changes.title: History final exam moved to Friday Dec 11, 4 to 6 PM
changes.announcement: Because of a scheduling conflict in the exam hall, the U.S. History final is now Friday Dec 11, 4:00 to 6:00 PM, in the Exam hall. It is no longer Monday Dec 14.

dev_must_notice.what: The U.S. History final moved to Friday Dec 11, 4:00 to 6:00 PM in the Exam hall (c-final.announcement, exam-hist-199-final-exam, announced 2:20 PM today). At 3:10 PM the store added a shift the same Friday, 5:00 to 10:00 PM (c-shift, 'Holiday rush, Friday added'). The two overlap from 5 to 6 PM, and she would arrive late to a closed-door exam or leave it early. Her usual study that afternoon (14:00 to 16:45, m-01) also runs into the exam, so nothing should be booked from 4 PM.

best_fix.what: A draft message to her Northgate Grocers supervisor for her to send: 'Hi, my History final was just moved to Friday Dec 11, 4 to 6 PM, and I saw the new 5 to 10 PM shift that day. Could I start at 6:30 PM instead, or be taken off that shift? I can cover Saturday or Sunday as usual.' Dev sends nothing itself and does not count the shift's pay.
best_fix.why: The shift was posted after the exam moved and one reply fixes it. Asking now keeps the schedule (posted two weeks ahead) from being locked.

best_fix.what: One tap adds two History review blocks with Undo: Mon Dec 7 and Wed Dec 9, 2:05 to 3:35 PM, in her afternoon study window, and leaves Friday Dec 11 from 4 PM empty for the exam. Nothing is added to the shift day.
best_fix.why: Mondays and Wednesdays she already studies at 2 PM after BUS 145 ends at 9:50; the exam takes the Friday slot only from 4 PM.

must_not: keep a study block on Fri Dec 11 at 4 PM or later, or leave the 5 PM shift unflagged
keep the old Monday Dec 14 date in any plan or reminder
send the supervisor message without her tap
count the added shift's pay before it is paid
write, solve or check anything for the exam (planning only)
book review in the evening or on Saturday or Sunday (she studies weekday afternoons; Sunday morning is free)
tags: exam must not be booked over
assumptions: The store posts schedules two weeks ahead and sometimes adds Friday shifts in the holiday rush.
The simulator draws the exam on the timeline as 4 to 5 PM; the real record (exam-hist-199-final-exam) runs 4:00 to 6:00 PM, and the case uses the record.
She drives to campus on her own insurance; Dev does not say anything about the car.

tempting.suggestion: keep a study block on Fri Dec 11 at 4 PM or later, or leave the 5 PM shift unflagged
tempting.why_wrong: Friday 4 to 6 PM is the exam itself and the new shift starts inside it
